# Bundled fonts

Distill uses three typographic roles in its reader template:

- **Source Serif 4** for article text
- **Source Sans 3** for headings and interface text
- **Source Code Pro** for code and preformatted text

The bundled files are the static TTF regular, bold, italic, and bold italic
faces. They are from the official Adobe Font repositories and are licensed
under the SIL Open Font License 1.1:

- Source Serif 4: <https://github.com/adobe-fonts/source-serif>
- Source Sans 3: <https://github.com/adobe-fonts/source-sans>
- Source Code Pro: <https://github.com/adobe-fonts/source-code-pro>

The OFL permits redistribution and modification. Keep this notice and the
upstream license information with the font files when packaging Distill.

The bundled DejaVu Sans and DejaVu Serif faces are covered by
[DejaVu-LICENSE.txt](DejaVu-LICENSE.txt).
